profile.headline: Software Engineer at Amazon
profile.summary:
I'm always looking to work on projects which challenge my ability to come up with innovative and creative solutions. 

I enjoy full stack opportunities where I can be given an ambiguous task and deliver an end to end scalable solution.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead developer, and full stack engineer using AWS, nodeJS and React to build features to help Amazon advertisers understand their performance.

Worked on features which would compare millions of search terms to show advertisers how they're performing against other advertisers, show an advertiser's change history, and reduce latency on our frontend dashboards.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Developed a frontend infrastructure and SDK for other teams to build UI dashboards on.

Providing reusable/extensible web components to be used across the site.
Developing localization, JIT resource loading, and multi-window web infrastructure for other teams to build on.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained the order management system for the payments platform which handled most business logic for all forms of payments that go through LinkedIn.

Among other tasks, I've helped add new forms of payment, enabled different kinds of trials, and have helped move the payments platform to be multi-master.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked in full stack agile team doing everything from optimizing SQL queries, to writing jquery widgets.

Helped design and develop tools to automate manual processes. 

Designed and devloped test infrastructure tools. 

Helped develop Web portals from scratch using new front end technologies like angularjs and bootstrap.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developing Financial Engines website/portals in Agile team.
Using Java, Struts 2, Spring, and Hibernate.

positions.title: Voice User Interface Application Developer
positions.description:
(Voxify was acquired by 24[7])

Designed, developed and maintained software for the Voice User Interface team which helps improve productivity and also helps analyze product performance. Primarily working in Ruby, Java and some SQL.

positions.title: Voice User Interface Application Developer - Part Time
positions.description: Designed, developed and maintained software for the Voice User Interface team which helps improve productivity and also helps analyze product performance. Primarily working in Ruby, Java and some SQL.

positions.title: Voice User Interface Analyst
positions.description: Analyse performance of existing applications and apply learnings to the improvement of future and current applications.

positions.title: Teacher Assistant
positions.description:
Worked with kids primarily in the first grade and kindergarten, however the after school program had kids ranging from grades K-5. 

As an assistant here I helped take care of the children and also planned a few lessons for the students.

volunteerExperiences.description: I do anything and everything to help the Make-a-Wish events run smoothly!
Helped green the city of San Francisco one tree at a time.
